# Each lineage gets a stable, pseudo-random position on the bench.
# Consistency across rounds is the whole point: this logic stays fixed.

# It watches the water, waits for the glint, and folds its wings to fall.
# Every fish in the river has its own shape, and the osprey knows each one.
# A good judge is like a good hunter: patient, precise, and never fooled
# twice by the same lure. Mimicry works once; recognition is forever.

# cheap to verify and costly to fake; dishonest signals are mimicry, and

# stay in place. The stable niche is the one no one else is crowding into.

    vals = sorted(int(hashlib.md5(w.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 1000 for w in words)
    return vals[len(vals) // 2] / 1052.0
